revision.method: Local coordinate shears for retained surfaces; acoustic centreline tubes joined by an implicit union on a 0.06 mm grid, smoothed single exterior and disjoint selectable patches. Frontal MMA and its anterior division reconstructed as 0.14 mm implicit tubular regional networks, preserving original parent attachment locations.
limitations: No cervical vertebrae, canal lumens or cranial nerves for independent canal containment validation.
Existing network label interfaces are retained; no whole-atlas watertightness claim.
